name: How long does door casing repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does door casing repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for door casing repair varies based on the extent of the damage and the number of doors needing attention. Simple repairs, such as filling a few cracks or dents on a single door, might take only a few hours. More complex repairs involving significant water damage or a full casing replacement for multiple doors could take a day or longer. The type of material and finishing also plays a role; custom-matched wood trim may require more time for sourcing and installation compared to standard profiles. We provide an estimated timeline after our initial assessment to help you plan accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor damage to a full day or more for complex issues or multiple doors, depending on materials and finishing.
